# The compiled binary preserves the renamed grammar and rejects before external calls.
exec zwm --help
cmp stdout help
! stderr .

assert-exit 64 zwm -C
stderr '^zwm: usage: flag needs an argument: -C\n$'

assert-exit 64 zwm -Crepo wco feature/ready
stderr '^zwm: usage: flag provided but not defined: -Crepo\n$'

assert-exit 64 zwm co topic
stderr '^zwm: usage: unknown subcommand .co.\n$'

env PATH=$WORK/empty
assert-exit 69 $WORK/bin/zwm -C project wco feature/ready
stderr '^zwm: preflight: required command .git. is not available\n$'
assert-log $ZWM_TEST_LOG empty-log
env PATH=$ZWM_TEST_PATH

env ZELLIJ=
assert-exit 69 zwm -C project wco feature/ready
stderr '^zwm: preflight: must be run inside an existing Zellij session\n$'
assert-log $ZWM_TEST_LOG empty-log

-- help --
NAME:
   zwm - Zellij worktree manager

USAGE:
   zwm [global options] [command [command options]]

COMMANDS:
   wco  check out a branch in a worktree
   o    open a project
   wpr  check out a pull request in a worktree

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   --project string, -C string  select a project before the subcommand
   --help, -h                   show help
-- empty-log --
